items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: Was that Peter Boccaz who was a corner player in that band?

ctx.x: Fats P. Well, Fats was coming up around in them days. Many times I went to Fats' house. He and I used to get together on the piano and trumpet. That's how long I know Fats. There used to be another friend of mine by the name of Al Corliss that played piano. That's a good friend of mine. He's in Steamship business today. He was a fine piano player too. But we used to like Fats. We used to like to hear Fats play. So we'd go call up Fats and go down to his house. Sit around, drink some coffee and start jamming. I…
Was that Peter Boccaz who was a corner player in that band?
Where, where? Out of the lake.
